# Ahmed Mohammed — AI/ML Engineer

> AI/ML Engineer based in Linz, Austria. M.Sc. in Artificial Intelligence from Johannes Kepler University Linz (Oct 2024 - Sep 2026; thesis submitted Jul 2026, supervised by Prof. Sepp Hochreiter). Builder of Sihem (LLM assistant) and Faultrix (AI QC platform). Specializing in computer vision, diffusion models, out-of-distribution detection, and industrial defect detection.

Last updated: 2026-09-06

## Identity

- **Full name:** Ahmed Mohammed
- **Location:** Linz, Upper Austria, Austria
- **Email:** ahmed.mo.0595@gmail.com
- **Portfolio:** https://ahmed-3m.github.io
- **Current work:** Sihem — LLM personal-mentor assistant, live beta (https://t.me/sihem_ai_bot)
- **Open to:** Senior AI/ML roles · Research collaborations · Enterprise partnerships

## Key Achievements

- 99.03% ± 0.07% average AUROC on CIFAR-10 airplane-vs-rest (binary, single ID class, 3-seed mean; not comparable to multi-class CIFAR-10 OOD leaderboards) — Master's Thesis, JKU Linz, 2026
- Introduced class-conditional separation loss improving OOD AUROC to 99.03% ± 0.07% (+6.5 percentage points over 92.52% ± 11.07% baseline, dramatically reducing seed volatility)
- 98.4% defect detection accuracy in production at PROFACTOR GmbH (Zer0P; internal deployment metric, threshold-dependent binary classification — not a public AUROC benchmark)
- Built Faultrix solo from zero to production — AI construction QC SaaS generating ÖNORM-compliant reports in under 1 minute

## Projects

- [Sihem](https://sihem-pwa.pages.dev/): Current project. LLM personal-mentor assistant in live beta — Telegram bot plus PWA. Built on Supabase edge functions (Deno/TS) with pgvector RAG long-term memory, multi-provider LLM routing (GLM/Gemini/Groq) with failover, and a deterministic generators-arbiter-composer decision engine. Try it at @sihem_ai_bot.
- [Faultrix](https://faultrix.com): Previous project (Jul 2025 – Jul 2026). AI-powered construction quality control SaaS. Analyzed building photos, generated ÖNORM B 2110-compliant technical reports in under 1 minute. SHA-256 evidence chain, DSGVO compliant, AES-256 encryption. Stack: Next.js, Convex, OpenAI API, Cloudflare R2, Stripe, Clerk, Docker.
- [OOD Detection Framework](https://github.com/ahmed-3m/DiffusionOOD): Novel use of conditional diffusion models as generative classifiers for out-of-distribution detection. 99.03% ± 0.07% average AUROC on CIFAR-10 airplane-vs-rest (binary, single ID class, 3-seed mean). Introduced class-conditional separation loss. Applied to industrial quality control with multi-head conditioning on the public FTI_Zer0P benchmark (0.8673 ± 0.0230 AUROC; thesis-documented).
- [Industrial Anomaly Detection](https://ahmed-3m.github.io/Diffusion-Based%20Multi-class%20Defect%20Detection.pdf): Early 2024 YOLO + diffusion model pipeline for industrial defect detection — a negative-result technical report that motivated the later thesis approach. (The FTI_Zer0P 0.8673 ± 0.0230 AUROC baseline is reported in the [Master's thesis](https://ahmed-3m.github.io/Mohammed_Ahmed_Thesis_Diffusion_OOD_Detection.pdf), not this report.)
- [EEG Signal Classification](https://github.com/ahmed-3m/Motor-Imagery-classification): LSTM, Bi-LSTM, GRU architectures for EEG motor imagery classification in brain-computer interface applications. Hyperparameter optimization across architectures (Karunya University, 2023).

## Research & Publications

- **Master's Thesis (2026):** "Conditional Diffusion Models as Generative Classifiers for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Inkjet Print Quality Control" — Johannes Kepler University Linz, supervised by Prof. Sepp Hochreiter and Claus Hofmann, MSc. [PDF](https://ahmed-3m.github.io/Mohammed_Ahmed_Thesis_Diffusion_OOD_Detection.pdf)
- **Industrial Technical Report (2024):** "Diffusion-Based Multi-class Defect Detection: A Generative Approach to Industrial QC" — PROFACTOR GmbH, Zer0P project. An early negative-result report that motivated the later thesis approach. [PDF](https://ahmed-3m.github.io/Diffusion-Based%20Multi-class%20Defect%20Detection.pdf)
- **Conference Paper (2023):** "Motor Imagery Classification Based Brain-Computer Interface for Rehabilitation" — Karunya University. [PDF](https://ahmed-3m.github.io/Motor%20Imagery%20classification%20Based%20Brain%20Computer.pdf)
- **Project Report (2023):** "Reading Thoughts Using GANs" — JKU Linz. [PDF](https://ahmed-3m.github.io/Reading%20Thoughts%20Using%20GANs.pdf)

## Education

- **M.Sc. Artificial Intelligence** — Johannes Kepler University Linz, Austria (Oct 2024 – Jul 2026). Supervisor: Prof. Sepp Hochreiter. Thesis: Conditional Diffusion Models for OOD Detection.
- **B.Sc. Mechatronics Engineering** — Eastern Mediterranean University, Famagusta, Cyprus (Feb 2015 – Jan 2018). Thesis: SCARA robotic system for dynamic object tracking.

## Experience

- **AI/ML Engineer, Sihem** (Jul 2026 – Present): Building an LLM personal-mentor assistant on Supabase edge functions (Deno/TS) with pgvector RAG memory, multi-provider LLM routing with failover, and a deterministic decision engine. In live beta at @sihem_ai_bot.
- **AI/ML & Full-Stack Engineer, Faultrix** (Jul 2025 – Jul 2026): Built AI construction analysis platform solo from zero to production.
- **ML Researcher, JKU Machine Learning Institute** (Dec 2024 – Jul 2026): Thesis on diffusion-based OOD detection under Prof. Sepp Hochreiter, pioneering separation loss (+6.5pp gain, 99.03% ± 0.07% average AUROC on airplane-vs-rest binary split).
- **Machine Vision Researcher, PROFACTOR GmbH / JKU Linz** (Apr 2024 – Nov 2024): YOLO + diffusion pipeline for industrial defect detection (M.Sc. thesis track 2). Strict 5-fold CV baseline of 0.8673 ± 0.0230 AUROC on the public FTI_Zer0P dataset.
- **AI Research Intern, Karunya University** (Aug 2023 – Oct 2023, Remote): RNN/CNN architectures for EEG motor imagery classification.
- **AI & Programming Tutor, Freelance** (Jan 2021 – Present): Python, ML, Deep Learning mentoring.
